en_title: GTA 6 Weather Still Not Varied Even After the Patch? PS5 Players Are Sharing a Method That May Help Rain and Thunderstorms Kick In
cn_title: 《GTA 6》打完补丁后天气仍然缺乏变化？PS5玩家分享了一种可能有助于触发降雨和雷暴的方法
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》首个发售后补丁修复了天气变化不足的问题，但部分玩家称天气仍鲜有变化。有PS5玩家分享了通过安全模式清除系统缓存的方法，称此后出现了更多雨天和风暴；这一方法也可能只是安慰剂效应。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar recently dropped the first post-launch patch for GTA 6 which, among other things, included a fix for the game’s lack of weather variety. Some players were left still experiencing issues, but now there’s seemingly a workaround for PS5 players specifically.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar最近为《GTA 6》发布了首个上市后补丁，其中包括一项针对游戏天气缺乏变化的修复。有些玩家仍然遇到问题，不过现在似乎有一种专门适用于PS5玩家的变通方法。

paragraphs.en: Lack of weather variety was something I noticed myself during the game’s review period, but Rockstar deployed a small fix during that time too. It was hard to tell whether it was working as intended because the weather also grows more stark as you move through the game.
paragraphs.cn: 在游戏评测期间，我自己也注意到了天气缺乏变化的问题，但Rockstar当时也发布了一项小修复。很难判断它是否按预期生效，因为随着游戏进程推进，天气也会变得更加极端。

paragraphs.en: “The weather types change throughout each day, and the overall weather pattern changes per chapter, evolving from generally very good weather in the first chapter to much more changeable and stormy in the last chapter,” said Owen Shepherd, vice president of art: lighting and rendering at Rockstar, when I asked.
paragraphs.cn: 当我询问时，Rockstar负责灯光与渲染的美术副总裁Owen Shepherd说：「天气类型在每天的各个时段都会变化，而整体天气模式也会随章节改变，从第一章总体上非常好的天气，逐渐变成最后一章更加多变、多暴风雨的天气。」

paragraphs.en: “This is analogous to Florida’s weather patterns in winter through to summer autumn. During the first chapters there are pockets of rain but due to the localization of weather it is possible to miss these."
paragraphs.cn: 「这类似于佛罗里达州从冬季到夏秋季节的天气模式。在最初几章中，部分地区会下雨，但由于天气具有局部性，玩家有可能错过这些降雨。」

paragraphs.en: However, it seems like the issue persisted into the live version of the game, blurring the line between thematically appropriate and accurate weather patterns and unintended bug. The latest patch fixed this for the most part, but some players found they were still experiencing minimal weather changes.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这个问题似乎一直持续到了游戏正式版本中，使得符合主题且准确的天气模式与非预期漏洞之间的界限变得模糊。最新补丁在很大程度上修复了这个问题，但有些玩家发现天气变化仍然很少。

paragraphs.en: If you’re having the same issue, there might be a fix (discovered by X / Twitter user @mauricioce85796 ). On PS5, you need to turn off your console and boot it into safe mode by holding the power button down until it beeps.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你遇到了同样的问题，可能有一种修复方法（由X用户@mauricioce85796发现）。在PS5上，你需要关闭主机，然后按住电源按钮直到听到提示音，让主机进入安全模式。

paragraphs.en: From there, choose option six and select “clear system cache.” According to people who have tested it, this forces the patch to do its job.
paragraphs.cn: 进入安全模式后，选择第六个选项，再选择「清除系统缓存」。据测试过这一方法的人说，这会强制补丁发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: “I have 56 hours in this game so far and I haven’t experienced any dramatic weather,” said Rockstar fan account Gameroll . “I did this and upon loading I was IMMEDIATELY met with this storm. I’m delighted.”
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar粉丝账号Gameroll说：「到目前为止，我已经玩了56个小时，却没有遇到过任何剧烈天气。我照着做了之后，加载游戏时立刻就遇到了这场暴风雨。我很高兴。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, this could be a placebo, but players in the replies have been trying it and immediately seeing results. “Guys, I can confirm, it’s working,” said one happy X / Twitter user who showcased a rainy clip. “Can confirm, weather is more varied!” said another .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，这可能只是安慰剂效应，但回复区的玩家试过之后立刻就看到了效果。一位高兴的X用户展示了一段下雨的片段，并说：「各位，我可以确认，确实有效。」另一位用户说：「可以确认，天气变化更多了！」

paragraphs.en: Clearing your cache on PS5 won’t delete game saves or installed games. It just deletes temporary system files and lets the console recreate fresh ones without erasing your games, saved data, screenshots, or account settings. It helps resolve system feature glitches, slow performance, stuttering, app or game launch errors, and network or sync hiccups. People have been doing it for years, claiming to see performance benefits as a result.
paragraphs.cn: 清除PS5缓存不会删除游戏存档或已安装的游戏。它只是删除临时系统文件，让主机重新创建新的文件，不会抹除你的游戏、存档数据、截图或账户设置。这有助于解决系统功能故障、运行缓慢、卡顿、应用或游戏启动错误，以及网络或同步方面的小问题。多年来一直有人这样做，并称因此获得了性能上的改善。
